critical_code_review_comments: Apply.jsx is now 3787 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Not a regression from this iteration but worth splitting the traveller-card, visa-step and summary blocks into sub-components in a future refactor.

The useEffect at Apply.jsx:1186 lists `travelers` in its dep-array while calling setTravelers. It correctly returns the same reference when nothing changes (`return changed ? next : list`), so no infinite loop. Confirmed empirically: 0 render-loop console warnings. Leave as is.

Contact-name prefill useEffect at line 1171 only fires for single-traveller applications and only when both first/last name are empty. Behaviour matches the spec (does not overwrite user edits). Good.
The `manualFieldsVisible` gate at line 2294 correctly ORs in `hasFieldErrors` so validation errors never remain hidden — matches the reviewer's explicit warning.
